# Compare an observed access mode with documented policy

1. Obtain the authorized configuration snapshot and identify the entry called access_mode.
2. Read the documented policy and record its expected access_mode and the source location.
3. Read the observed access_mode from the snapshot without changing it. Retain the snapshot reference.
4. Compare the documented and observed values. An equal value supports consistency with that policy;
   a different value supports a mismatch requiring investigation, not an independently proven vulnerability.
5. If either value is absent, record the comparison as unknown and identify the missing input.

Record the policy reference, snapshot reference, both values and the comparison result. This procedure
performs no target interaction and does not claim any observation has already been made.
